## Background and Maintainer

This pipeline was developed during Franck Pan's internship as his main project during the summer of 2026 at the [Friedrich Miescher Institute for Biomedical Research](https://www.fmi.ch/){target="_blank"} in the [Peter's Lab](https://www.fmi.ch/research-groups/groupleader.html?group=41), and it is being maintained by **Franck Pan**.

## Requirements

- Nextflow v25.10.4, Conda (latest)
- There is no minimum system requirement, but depending on your dataset the pipeline can be very system-hungry - <u><b>the more CPU/RAM the better </b></u>, and <u><b>enough disk space</b></u> is essential.
